name: HyperTree Proof Search (HTPS)
one_liner: Online AlphaZero-style MCTS over proof hypergraphs in Lean and Metamath, training tactic policy and value networks from their own searches.

loop.proposes: A transformer policy network proposes multiple Lean or Metamath tactics at open goals in an AND-OR proof hypergraph.
loop.judged_by: The formal proof kernel checks every tactic step and splits conjunctive subgoals into hypergraph children.
loop.steers: PUCT hypergraph tree search balances exploration and value estimates, and the policy and value models train online on data from their own searches.

headline_result: Solved 82.6% of Metamath set.mm test theorems and 41.0% of miniF2F-curriculum theorems in Lean, discovering shorter proofs than human ground truth.
caveat: AND-OR hypergraph expansion requires all sibling subgoals of a tactic to close before a parent goal is proved.
beyond_harness_note: An online PUCT hypergraph search algorithm calls the neural policy/value networks and trains them online on data from its own searches.
generative_model: Online-trained encoder-decoder tactic and value transformers
algorithmic_authority: Lean / Metamath kernel and PUCT AND-OR hypergraph search

sources.title: HyperTree Proof Search for Neural Theorem Proving (NeurIPS 2022 / arXiv:2205.11491)

verification.notes: Checked against Lample et al., NeurIPS 2022.
